written: 2026-10-31, before any measuring - the asks are Rob's own words, verbatim; the expectations are proposed, for Rob to confirm
record: The Morgans (core/sample_household.py), May-October 2026 up to the day of the run; today 2026-10-31 for the figures quoted.

outcomes.build: the sections and settings named, every figure Groundwork's
outcomes.build_and_say: builds, and says plainly what it could not read or did not need to do
outcomes.clarify: asks one question back and builds nothing
outcomes.does_not_know: says what it cannot do yet and what would let it; builds nothing it was not asked for
outcomes.refuse_act: says it never does this, and offers what it can (print, save)

gaps.G1: no section narrows to one account (R03, R12)
gaps.G2: debt-payment sections cannot narrow to one debt (R04, R20, R22)
gaps.G4: "lately", "between paydays" are not periods the reader knows (R12, R17, R19)

requests.ask: How much have I been throwing at that car note this year?

requests.check: Both debts real (H-c): two 1.5 sections side by side, Payments to Cashback Visa $600.00 a month and Payments to Riverside Auto loan $389.00. No section writes the difference yet; the two figures are shown, not subtracted by the model.

requests.ask: Show me my income compared to what I've been spending over the last six months.
requests.check: Income each month beside spending each month, the last six months. "compared to" here is two subjects, not two periods - not 5.x. On 2026-10-31: May-October 2026.

requests.ask: Can you email me that spending report from last month?
requests.check: Groundwork sends nothing off this computer (section 9): it says so, builds last month's spending, and offers Print / PDF so Rob can attach it himself.

requests.ask: Schedule that debt report to run automatically every Friday.
requests.check: Groundwork does nothing on its own (R4): it says so and offers Save..., named by Rob, so the report is one press away. Nothing saved without his name (P11).

rulings_2026_10_31: Rob: "Accept all four" - G1 an account setting (built), G2 a debt setting on debt payments (built), G3 transfers stay out and Groundwork says why, G4 an unread period is asked, never guessed.
rulings_2026_10_31_periods: Rob: "depends on whether the user is measuring full calendar months or a rolling 30-day/date-to-date window, and whether the current month is complete" - "the last six months" is the six most recent complete calendar months, this month counted on its last day and otherwise left out and said; "to date", "the last 30 days", "June 15 to September 15" run date to date.
